gizmo.title: Tchati cha Mipiringidzo
gizmo.description: Imapanga tchati chopezeka kwa onse chochokera ku CSV.

configure.title: Dzina la Muyeso
configure.description: Chiyerekezo cha m'lifupi:kutalika kwa tchati (Onani https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings kuti mupeze $ct-scales ndi $ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Mipiringidzo Yopingasa
configure.description: Imatembenuza ma axis a tchati cha mipiringidzo kuti ijambule tchati cha mipiringidzo yopingasa. Dziwani kuti mufunikanso kutembenuza zokonda zanu za axis popeza Y Axis tsopano idzaonetsa zizindikiro ndipo X Axis mitengo.

configure.title: Unjikani Mipiringidzo
configure.description: Ngati ili true, izi zidzapangitsa mipiringidzo ya magulu kuunjikidwa.

configure.title: Gawani Magulu
configure.description: Ngati ili true, mpiringidzo uliwonse udzaimira gulu ndipo gulu la deta likuyembekezeka kukhala la mbali imodzi la mitengo m'malo mwa gulu la magulu.

advanced.title: Tembenuzani Deta
advanced.description: Tembenuzani deta kuphatikizapo zizindikiro, kutsatana kwa magulu komanso magulu onse a deta.

advanced.title: Tebulo la HTML

advanced.title: Njira Younjikira
advanced.description: Ngati ili "true" izi zidzapanga chiwerengero chonse pa mfundo iliyonse ya gulu. Izi zidzakhudzanso y-axis ndi malire onse a tchati. Ngati ili "false" izi zidzakakamiza mipiringidzo youunjikidwa kujambulidwa kuchokera pa mzere wa ziro. M'njira youunjikira, "seriesBarDistance" sidzagwira ntchito.
